products.name: Bosch Series 2 8 kg fully automatic top-load washing machine
products.summary: Lift the soft-closing black glass lid and look down at the PowerWave pulsator, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: Body only, 95 cm tall; with the lid open it is about 140 cm
specs: PowerWave: the pulsator, a dynamic water flow and drum movement
Normal, Eco wash, Delicates, Quick, Mix, Cottons, Water Save, Spin, Heavy, Tub clean
Water level (01 to 10), Delay up to 24 h, Easy Start, Child Lock
Soft closing, hinged at the back, black glass top
52 dB(A) re 1 pW, washing (Bosch gives 65 dB(A) for the Silver model)
220-240 V, 50 Hz, 5 A fuse, India plug (6 A), 135 cm cord

hotspots.title: Soft Closing Lid
hotspots.text: It provides a gradual lid closure to ensure an injury-free and silent closing of the washer lid.

hotspots.title: PowerWave Wash System
hotspots.text: PowerWave Wash System is a combination of the innovatively designed pulsator, dynamic waterflow system and intelligent drum movement which gives perfect wash results.

hotspots.title: 24h delay start
hotspots.text: Greater flexibility thanks to freely selectable program start delay (24 h).

hotspots.title: Inverter Motor
hotspots.text: The VarioInverter motor is a powerful, durable and highly efficient motor that provides optimum washing performance that is backed with warranty.
